Hi Samantha,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the onboarding for ProcureCo. To get us moving on the first PO and ongoing ordering cadence, can you confirm the following so procurement can complete vendor setup?

1) PO acceptance and format
- Do you accept electronic POs (PDF) and structured CSV uploads?
- Do you require a specific PO line-item schema (MPN/SKU, description, qty, unit price, currency)?

2) Timeline for first issued PO
- Typical lead time between issuance and invoice for a new customer setup
- Any required vendor-side setup tasks we should schedule (banking/W9 verification, EDI onboarding)

3) Line-item expectations
- Preferred fields per line (we typically include internal GL code, bill-to entity, and a short product description)
- Whether you can accept a blanket PO with periodic releases or prefer single POs per order

If you can attach your vendor intake form and any AP/PO templates it would be great. From our side, I will circulate a short checklist for the vendor profile fields we need to create the supplier record in our ERP.

Goal: complete vendor setup and issue the first PO within 10 business days if possible.

Thanks — look forward to your intake form.

Best,

Hi Grace — thanks for the clear checklist. Answers inline below and I attached our standard intake and tax form: ProcureCo_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf, ProcureCo_W9.pdf.

> 1) PO acceptance and format
- We accept signed PDF POs via email and structured CSV (SFTP) uploads for recurring orders. Our AP team can ingest CSV with the following columns: PO#, Line#, SKU, Description, Qty, UnitPrice, Currency, MPN. If you need an SFTP drop, we can provision one during onboarding.

> 2) Timeline for first issued PO
- Typical: 7–12 business days to complete vendor profile + banking verification. Once profile is active, we can accept POs immediately. For one-off emergency orders we do expedited onboarding in 3–4 days with a temporary payment hold.

> 3) Line-item expectations
- Required per line: SKU/MPN or vendor part number, line description (max 250 chars), quantity, unit price, currency. Optional fields: internal reference, GL code.
- We support blanket POs with release dates (recommended for recurring consumables).

Attached: ProcureCo_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (fillable)
ProcureCo_W9.pdf

Next steps: I can fill the intake form with your company details if you prefer; otherwise, return the completed form and we will queue your profile for validation.

Regards,
Samantha Ruiz

ProcureCo Inc.

Thanks Samantha — that matches our expectations. A couple internal notes for ProcureCo compatibility so AP/ERP setup is smooth:

- Mandatory PO header fields from Redwood side: PO Number, Issue Date, Bill-To Name (legal entity), Bill-To Address, Ship-To (if applicable), Payment Terms (Net30 default), Tax ID (EIN), Contact for invoicing.
- Mandatory PO line fields: Line#, SKU/MPN, Short Description, Quantity, Unit Price, Currency, Extended Amount, Internal GL Code (we will populate but need field available).
- We prefer CSV uploads for recurring POs. Please confirm column heading tolerance (case-insensitive OK) and whether you accept an additional column for our internal project code.

I've attached our PO export template for your ingestion team — redwood_po_template.csv. If ProcureCo can map to those headers we can automate our recurring order flow. Also Samantha, confirm whether your AP needs the vendor bank routing info up front or only on the first invoice.

Best,
